title: Mace

steps.prompt: A one-handed flanged mace standing upright, head up: a heavy iron head with six thick blunt flanges, short sturdy wooden haft, leather grip, iron ring at the base. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. High-end anime fantasy RPG key visual, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, detailed ornate equipment with engraved metal, layered cloth and leather, realistic proportions, expressive anime faces, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, original design, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 4000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 1024 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 0.75 m, origin at the centre of the base.
